editorial.name: Bizzabo
editorial.descriptionZh: Bizzabo 是给 B2B 会议做的活动体验操作系统，注册报名、活动官网与议程、App、现场智能胸牌、直播和赞助商管理都在里面。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看活动平台怎么把九个模块摆成产品矩阵
editorial.noteZh: 最顶上一条黑色通栏写 Webinar: Join Adam Parry (Event Tech Live) and Kayla Drake for a live playbook on field events that build pipeline.，右边 REGISTER NOW；导航排 Products / Solutions / Klik / Resources / About Us / Pricing，蓝色 Get a Demo 在右端。首屏是会场人群的虚化照片，上方一行小字 The Bizzabo Event Experience OS，大标题衬线体 The intelligence behind every great event，下面三组评分：G2 CROWD 437 reviews、Capterra 171 reviews、Gartner Peer Insights 71 reviews，再下面一条 logo 墙排着 amazon、Bloomberg、Financial Times、WSJ、TIME、AVAYA、Forbes、HubSpot。产品区按 Event Registration、Website and Agenda Editor、Mobile Event App、Event Networking、Email and Marketing Management、Sponsor/Exhibitor/Speaker Management、Video/Broadcasting/Streaming、Klik SmartBadges™、Professional Services 依次展开。
editorial.pricing: unknown（导航有 Pricing，首页只给 Get a Demo）

reasons.statement: 这是 Bizzabo 自家的活动软件官网，从 saaslandingpage.com 收进候选池；交付的是企业订阅加 Get a Demo，页面主体是产品矩阵与评分背书，归产品与公司官网。
拿不准：Bizzabo Studios 与 /podcast、/blog、/event-resources 让它带一点内容站的成分，但首页本身仍是产品页，内容只挂在导航末端。
